name: Fluconazole
reviewed_by: William Gregory M. Rivero, MD, FPCP, DPSN
drafted_by: AI-assisted draft (Claude) for review by Dr. W. Rivero

usual_adult_dose.dose: 200 mg day 1, then 100 mg daily for at least 2 weeks
200 mg day 1, then 100 mg daily (up to 400 mg/day)
400 mg day 1, then 200 mg daily (400 mg daily by judgment)

serious: QT prolongation and torsades de pointes

contraindications: Coadministration of QT-prolonging CYP3A4 substrates (erythromycin, pimozide, quinidine)
monitoring: QT and electrolytes when at risk
